notes.title: One week patch! - Text not visible!
notes.content: A couple of people were having a issue with the texts. It seems that some computers forced a different resolution which moved the text. This issue is fixed![img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35319060/f4d7fcb9415e2ccfba508fe2c48433b37b7c23fa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: First day patch! - Videos stutter or crash the game!
notes.content: Some people were having issues with high processor usage when loading the in-game videos. This patch will half the processor usage when loading these videos. [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35319060/2327b076bed6e15675c43ea0ab06c30a9c36b882.jpg[/img]
